features.summary: Merchants page: status tabs All/Active/Pending approval/Suspended with server counts (one-row list calls), a Groups tab (client-groups CRUD) and a Verification tab (KYC review). Merchant page: header actions (approve, suspend, reactivate, group move, adjust wallet, credit limit), tabs Orders, Wallet ledger (four balances, paged statement, official statement download, journal dialog), Pricing (client overrides) and API access (list/revoke keys). Every figure (wallet, 30-day stats, group price, floor) comes from the server; the console only formats and shows problem+json refusals.

endpoints.query: Paging _start/_end (25 per page). Tab counts: _start=0&_end=1 with only status (or nothing for All). Other features (orders, finance, commissions, services) read _start=0&_end=200&_sort=name&_order=asc; palette sends q with _end=5. _sort: name | status only (default name asc; merchants/lib/filters.ts:70). Filters (eq): status=active|pending|suspended, groupId=<id>. q: case-insensitive contains over name, email, company (mock also username, country: mocks/clientRoutes.ts:12). Refetched every 30 s.

Only for callers holding wallet:read: wallet {balance, reserved, creditLimit, available} (same meaning as GET /admin/clients/:id/wallet) and stats over a rolling 30 days of orders.created_at: orders (count), spend (sum total_price of non-rejected orders), profit (sum total_price - total_cost of completed), margin (profit/spend*100 as decimal string with 1 dp, null when spend is 0), successRate (completed/(completed+rejected)*100 as a JSON number, null when none finished), lastOrderAt (latest order created_at or null). Without wallet:read omit both (UI shows dashes). Build joins in one batched query per page. Never send password_hash, totp_secret_enc, telegram_chat_id or notification_prefs.

businessRules: Status machine: pending->active (approve), active->suspended (reason 3-140 chars), suspended->active (reactivate); anything else 409. Suspended merchants cannot place new orders on any surface; open orders keep processing; wallet untouched (SuspendMerchantDialog.tsx:1-2; demo 42-p-merchants.js m-suspend; MerchantHeader.tsx:76-106). Each change writes audit_logs with from/to and reason (demo 11-state.js:329-335).

Approving an account does not require an approved verification: the demo pending note says "KYC is in review. The merchant cannot place orders until you approve the account." (MerchantNote.tsx:34-38). Any policy refusal must be a problem+json the toast can show (MerchantsActions.test.tsx:40-56).

Group move prices new orders only (open orders keep orders.pricing_snapshot); merchants can never be put in the b2c_retail group (lib/groups.ts:6-16; client_groups kind = b2c_retail is the single storefront group).

Wallet figures come from the ledger: moneyEvent "order" (Dr client_wallet / Cr client_hold) holds the price, "reject" returns it (Dr client_hold / Cr client_wallet), "complete" moves it to revenue (Dr client_hold / Cr revenue, plus Dr cogs / Cr supplier_prepaid). So balance excludes reserved and available = balance + creditLimit; an order is refused when available < price (money.json order.need "اشحن الرصيد أولاً"; mocks/dto.ts:14-21).

Manual adjustment = moneyEvent "adjust" (credit: Dr adjustments / Cr client_wallet; debit mirrored), ledger kind "adjustment", in one DB transaction with the balance update and audit_logs; entries are never edited or deleted, corrections are reverse entries (scenario system-integrity step 6: "القيود لا تُعدَّل ولا تُحذف").

Adjustment refusals the dialog shows: amount over the approval limit -> 409 APPROVAL_REQUIRED (demo $10,000, walletRoutes.ts:14,47); debit taking balance below -creditLimit -> 409 CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (walletRoutes.ts:55; demo 42-p-merchants.js:126); reason at least 5 characters (AdjustWalletDialog.tsx:86-90).

Credit limit = client_wallet.overdraft_limit, >= 0, 0 removes the credit; only for merchants whose group has overdraft_allowed (GroupDialog label "Merchants in this group can use a credit limit"); audit entry; no ledger entry (M55).

Balance updates use ledger_accounts.version (optimistic lock) so concurrent holds, deposits and adjustments cannot overspend; the statement, wallet and reconciliation all read the same client_wallet account.

API keys: staff can only list and revoke (M45); revoke sets revoked_at, acts immediately (key cache), writes audit_logs (manifest tables api_keys, audit_logs); key_hash is never returned; a second revoke is 409 ALREADY_REVOKED (kycRoutes.ts:69).

Client groups: exactly one default group (groupRoutes.ts:26-31); names unique case-insensitive (groupRoutes.ts:33-34); delete refused while merchants are in it with 409 GROUP_IN_USE (groupRoutes.ts:96); groups created through the API get kind "b2b" (groupRoutes.ts:60); the b2c_retail group cannot be deleted; a discount change applies to the next orders only (useClientGroups.ts:41-53).

Client prices: price must be >= the service floor (cost + minimum profit) else 422 on price (priceRoutes.ts:13-21; demo setPrice floor rule in 11-state.js); one price per (client, service) else 409 PRICE_EXISTS (priceRoutes.ts:48); it beats group price, category rule and discounts (api/prices.ts:1-3); deleting returns the merchant to the group price from the next order.

KYC decide: pending only (409 ALREADY_DECIDED, kycRoutes.ts:41); reject needs a note (kycRoutes.ts:39); sets clients.kyc_status (kycRoutes.ts:51; manifest tables kyc_submissions, clients), reviewed_by, reviewed_at; the merchant is notified.

Invite: account starts pending with kyc_status none, unique email (409 EMAIL_TAKEN), default group when groupId is omitted (clientRoutes.ts:57-74), sign-up link emailed with a hashed one-time token (identity scenario admin-team step 2 pattern).

Permissions per route (M7 reading of x:*): clients:read/create/update; wallet:read, wallet:adjust, wallet:credit_limit; reports:read (official statement); api_keys:read, api_keys:revoke; groups:read/create/update/delete; pricing:read/create/update/delete; kyc:read, kyc:decide. Wallet and 30-day stats inside client rows require wallet:read (M52).

businessRules: Deposit approval posts map moneyEvent "deposit" (Dr gateway_clearing or bank for the gross, Cr client_wallet net, Cr fee_income fee) in one DB transaction with payment -> approved and invoice -> paid, ref_type payment, then emits EVENT invoice.paid (manifest EVENT invoice.paid; finance/mocks/paymentHandlers.ts:19-41,80-100; demo 10-data.js:515-520).
A deposit is decided once: approve and reject only from pending, else 409 PAYMENT_ALREADY_REVIEWED (paymentHandlers.ts:51; demo 11-state.js reviewPayment).

Reject needs a reason, stores it as the payment note shown to the merchant, voids the top-up invoice and moves no money (paymentHandlers.ts:102-119; RejectPaymentDialog copy "The merchant wallet is not changed").

The merchant pays the gateway fee on top: netAmount = amount - feeAmount is credited (money.json deposit note "التاجر يدفع 103$ والرسوم 3$ عليه"); card/USDT top-ups confirmed by the signed webhook arrive approved and post the same deposit event exactly once (ledger_transactions.idempotency_key; types/payments.ts:10).

The ledger is append-only: entries are never edited or deleted, every transaction sums to zero, corrections are reverse entries (money.json ledger_entries "مجموعها صفر"; scenario system-integrity step 6).

Reconciliation is read-only ("الفحص يقرأ فقط ولا يصحّح شيئاً بنفسه", scenario system-integrity step 3) and compares stored balances with entry sums; difference = stored - expected (types/accounts.ts:28-37).
Trial balance is per account kind, debit-positive, totals from the same rows (finance/mocks/books.ts:13-33); the finance strip reads kinds bank and supplier_prepaid and the exposure totals (M129).
Manual invoices: kind manual, status open, numbered by the server (INV-YYYY-NNNN, mocks/invoices.ts:36-38), due in 14 days (invoiceHandlers.ts:81), no ledger entry at issue.

Profit report counts completed orders only; revenue is net of VAT (b2c_deliver moves 12.49 net to revenue, VAT stays in vat_payable) and cost is cogs; a loss shows as negative profit (ReportsTab chart draws it as zero).
VAT is computed from ledger entries (vat_payable lines), by tax country and month, not from invoices (manifest GET /admin/reports/vat description).

Supplier top-ups (moneyEvent topup: Dr supplier_prepaid / Cr bank) and gateway settlements (payout: Dr bank / Cr gateway_clearing) feed the trial balance; no admin route records them in this feature (M37/M61).
Withdrawals are out of scope: no route reads or decides withdrawal_requests (M3).

Permissions: ledger:read (ledger list/show, trial balance), ledger:reconcile, payments:read, payments:approve (approve and reject), invoices:read/create (M7 reading of invoices:*), reports:read (profit, wallet exposure), reports:finance (VAT).

Group the ready accruals by beneficiary and post one map moneyEvent "commission" per agent for the batch sum: Dr commission_expense / Cr client_wallet (agent), ledger kind "commission", ref_type accrual, ref_id = first accrual id, memo "Commission batch, N accruals to <agent>"; set each accrual status approved and ledger_tx_id (approved_at proposed); audit entry per agent; all in one DB transaction.
endpoints.response: 200 {approved (count approved), total (money actually posted, 4 dp), skipped: [{id, reason}]}. Clean run: toast "N commissions approved" / "$X credited to M agent wallets." from total; any skipped: summary dialog with each reason (ApproveResultDialog).

endpoints.mapConflict: Map route tables are commission_accruals and ledger_entries only; posting also writes ledger_transactions, ledger_accounts (agent wallet balance) and audit_logs. The map books the commission expense at approval, not at accrual (moneyEvent commission).

businessRules: Accruals are created by the system when an order of a referred merchant completes (moneyEvent commission need: "العمولة تُستحق على طلب مكتمل"): plan_id, beneficiary_id, order_id, period YYYY-MM, basis_amount (order revenue), percent (plan rate at that moment), amount = basis x percent / 100, status accrued, no ledger entry yet (commissions/mocks/seed.ts:125-127).

Approval posts map moneyEvent "commission" once per agent: Dr commission_expense / Cr client_wallet(agent) for the sum of that agent ready accruals, ref_type accrual, ref_id first accrual id; accruals become approved with ledger_tx_id (mocks/accrualRoutes.ts:34-72, mocks/ledger.ts:23-41; demo 11-state.js:292-313).

Bulk approval skips instead of failing: unknown -> "This accrual does not exist.", not accrued -> "Already approved." (accrualRoutes.ts:46-47); an empty or invalid ids list is 422 on ids (accrualRoutes.ts:40). The answer total is what was really posted; the console preview is display only (M157).
The 7-day refund wait is a hint, not a rule: "Normally approved after 7 days to cover refunds. You can approve earlier." (AccrualsToolbar.tsx:44).
A plan rate change applies only to orders completed after the save; existing accruals keep their percent (api/plans.ts:45-47; PlanDialog hint "Applies to orders completed from now on").
Plan rate between 0.5 and 15 percent (planRoutes.ts:28, demo plan-edit); kind referral|rebate; basis and period required; tiers must be a JSON object.
Deleting a plan that agents are assigned to is refused with 409 PLAN_IN_USE (planRoutes.ts:118).
One current plan per merchant: a second assignment is 409 ALREADY_ASSIGNED (assignmentRoutes.ts:48); scope and starts_at are set by the server (assignmentRoutes.ts:57).
Ending an assignment stops accruals on new orders only; earned accruals stay as they are (EndAssignmentDialog.tsx:1-2).
Approval changes the agent wallet at once: GET /admin/clients/:id/wallet, the statement and the client list wallet read the same client_wallet account (ASSUMED commissions Q7).

Permissions: commissions:read (page, accruals list/show), commissions:create/update/delete (plans and assignments, M7 reading of commissions:*), commissions:approve (approve, Select all); Assign plan also needs clients:read for its menu (M160).

crossCutting: List dialect (simple-rest): _start/_end row range (end exclusive), _sort/_order comma-joined parallel lists, field filters by bare name (repeated key = IN) or with suffix _ne/_gte/_lte/_gt/_lt/_like, free text q; total in x-total-count (missing header -> total = rows received). Evidence: src/lib/api/query.ts:34-55, src/lib/api/client.ts:140-153, src/mocks/crud.ts:24-137.

CORS: requests use credentials: include and send X-CSRF-Token on non-GET; responses must expose x-total-count, Content-Disposition, X-Request-Id, Retry-After and X-CSRF-Token (Access-Control-Expose-Headers) with an explicit origin and Allow-Credentials. Evidence: src/lib/api/client.ts:71-84,149,167; src/lib/api/errors.ts:205-206; src/lib/api/csrf.ts:30-33; src/mocks/crud.ts:167.

Page size: the console asks for up to 1000 rows (commissions Select all, src/features/commissions/hooks/keys.ts:34) and 200 for whole-list lookups (src/features/merchants/hooks/keys.ts:28, src/features/finance/api/lookups.ts:7, src/features/commissions/hooks/keys.ts:25-28); the server page cap must be >= 1000.

Money: every money field is a decimal string with exactly 4 fraction digits in responses; requests send 4-dp strings (src/features/merchants/lib/amount.ts:13-19, src/features/finance/lib/invoices.ts:47-51). Percents/rates are decimal strings: requests may send "4", "2.5", "3.5" (merchants/lib/amount.ts:31-38, commissions/components/PlanDialog.tsx:67), responses normalise to "4.0000". Never JSON numbers for money (src/lib/api/types.ts:7-11).

Ledger sign: ledger_entries.amount and account balances are debit-positive, credit-negative; the lines of one transaction sum to zero (src/features/finance/types/index.ts:26-29, types/accounts.ts:8). Merchant-facing figures (client wallet, statement, wallet-exposure, payments client.walletBalance) are flipped to the merchant side, positive = merchant money (src/features/merchants/mocks/figures.ts:41-70, src/features/finance/mocks/books.ts:46-47).

Map moneyEvent -> ledger_transactions.kind the console labels (src/features/finance/lib/kinds.ts:4-18): deposit->deposit, order->order_hold, complete and b2c_deliver->order_settle, reject->order_release, topup->supplier_topup, commission->commission, adjust->adjustment, b2c_pay->b2c_payment, b2c_fee->gateway_fee, b2c_refund->refund, b2c_chargeback->chargeback, payout->settlement, opening balances->opening (withdrawal unused, M3). Account kinds = the map ids (src/features/finance/lib/accounts.ts:10-25, which also names owner_capital).

Dates: date-times are ISO 8601 UTC strings (src/lib/api/types.ts:13-14); date-only params from/to are YYYY-MM-DD, both inclusive, computed in the browser time zone (src/features/finance/lib/reports.ts:33-55), so the server needs one business time-zone setting; createdAt_gte receives a full ISO date-time (src/features/commissions/lib/figures.ts:16-18).

Errors: application/problem+json {type, title, status, code, detail, errors[{field, message}]} plus X-Request-Id (src/mocks/problem.ts:10-24, src/lib/api/errors.ts:190-208). errors[].field must equal the request body camelCase name (dialogs map by name; only GroupDialog aliases, GroupDialog.tsx:21); 422 VALIDATION_FAILED for bad input; business refusals 409 with a specific code and a human detail (dialogs show detail, direct buttons toast title + detail); only EMAIL_TAKEN is mapped to a field by code (src/components/ui/dialogSubmit.ts:35-51, InviteMerchantDialog.tsx:53).

Success statuses: create POST 201 with the created row (src/mocks/crud.ts:190); action POST 200 with a JSON body; PATCH 200 with the full updated row; DELETE 204 empty (src/lib/api/client.ts:96-99 treats 204/empty as no body).

Joins are nested objects ({id, name, ...}) or null; unknown extra fields are ignored, so adding fields is safe; ids are JSON numbers and the PAY-/JRN-/INV-/CA-/ORD- prefixes are display only (src/lib/api/types.ts:5, src/features/finance/lib/payments.ts:25, finance/lib/ledgerView.ts:51-55 strips JRN-/# before sending q).

Counts are one-row list calls read from x-total-count (useMerchantCounts.ts:13-23, finance usePaymentCounts.ts, commissions useAccrualCounts.ts/useStripCounts.ts:17), so filtered totals must be exact; the console never sums money, so all totals come from report routes (M49, M129, M154).

Currency: all ledger money is in the base currency (USD); responses carry currency as the ISO code string where a body has one (trial balance, reports, invoices, payments) although generated rows type it as an id (src/lib/api/schema.gen.ts:452,501).

Permissions: CRUD rows tagged x:* are read as x:read/x:create/x:update/x:delete (MISMATCHES M7); response parts can be permission-gated (GET /admin/clients wallet/stats need wallet:read); the console hides or disables controls but always shows the server 403.
